summary: Added shacl_path_to_rdflib(graph, node) to rdflib/paths.py, returning a URIRef for simple predicates and a Path (InvPath, AlternativePath, MulPath, or SequencePath) for complex SHACL paths, with ValueError on malformed input. Nothing committed; docs/utilities.rst not updated.
